oracle_boundary: Native success is allowed as terminal training reward and evaluation label; actor input/online stop use observed geometry, frame velocity and declared family, not true bias or native success.
native_success_contract: position<=.005m and angle<=.2rad at physical step200
observable_completion_contract: current source:4mm/.12rad enter,4.6mm/.16rad exit,20Hz pose-delta velocity<=.02m/s and .3rad/s,3 unique-step dwell; historical smoke source versions retained
controls_expected: full geometry/search; all-authority original and fast deduplicated search; full RLS and legacy controls on two-scene diagnostic panel; absence is not zero cost

completion_definitions.ever_success: any recorded native criterion true; auxiliary only
completion_definitions.hold_entered_before_native: hold entered while native criterion false; may later become successful, so not automatically false termination
completion_definitions.hold_final_failure: observable hold entered but native final failure
completion_definitions.hold_then_lost: native success at hold entry but native final failure
